Cc: Compliance Portal <compliance@arcadebank.com>
Date: 2026-08-22 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Request: standby activation proof + RPO timestamps

Hi Priya,

As part of our SIG intake we need concrete artifacts demonstrating Redwood's ability to stand up a standby region and meet the stated RPOs. Specifically: 1) a timeline of activation (trigger -> services live) for any recent warm-start exercise, 2) RPO timestamp log demonstrating last persisted offsets for primary and replica, and 3) any exec-summary evidence from the exercise (who was involved, systems exercised).

Can you share a sample CSV with the timestamp offsets and a brief playbook excerpt that shows the activation steps we can attach to the SIG response? We may request a short witness session if artifacts look good.

Thanks,
John
John Reynolds
Senior Security Analyst — Arcade Bank
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: standby activation proof + RPO timestamps

John —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached are the artifacts from our most recent warm-standby exercise (2026-08-21 -> 2026-08-27 validation window):
- rpo-timestamps-20260821-20260827.csv (primary/replica offsets + UTC timestamps)
- standby-activation-playbook.pdf (playbook excerpt showing trigger conditions, failover steps, smoke-tests)

Quick notes:
- The CSV includes a per-shard offset column and the last-persisted tx id reported by our storage layer at 03:12:41Z on 2026-08-26 (this was the latest successful checkpoint before the exercise).
- Our warm-standby approach is based on streaming replication with periodic snapshots; typical RPO is quantified as "<= 30s" under normal load; the attached trace demonstrates sub-25s deltas for the exercised shards.

Ben and Marissa are copied to provide the lower-level traces and any additional phonetic logs you want. If you'd like a live walk-through, we can schedule a 30–45 minute witness call and replay the activation timeline.

Action items we propose:
1) Review attached CSV + playbook; let us know if you need specific shard IDs redacted.
2) If acceptable, confirm a slot for a witness session (we can do next Tue/Wed morning PT).
3) We'll prepare a short signed attestation template for your legal/compliance team once you confirm the evidence set.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, John Reynolds <john.reynolds@arcadebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: standby activation proof + RPO timestamps

John / Priya —

Adding the technical trace you asked for. Attached: kv-warm-cache-trace.log — this is an anonymized extract from our cache/kv layer showing the last-write timestamps and the subsequent replay offsets during the warm activation on 2026-08-26 at 03:12:41Z. A few clarifying points:
- The activation sequence is start trigger -> orchestrator loads last checkpoint -> replay stream from offset N -> service healthchecks -> traffic cutover. The attached playbook excerpt enumerates these steps and the smoke tests we run against latency-sensitive endpoints.
- The CSV maps shard->offset->primary_ts->replica_ts; fields are in UTC ISO format. We removed per-customer ids but left internal shard identifiers so you can verify continuity.
- Duration from trigger to service-ready varied by shard; the median was 00:00:18 and the 95th percentile was 00:00:34 in this exercise. Both numbers are within the SLO band we publish.

If you need a filtered sample for a particular product line, tell me which logical shard or model id and I’ll extract it. Also happy to walk through the log lines on a call — I can share my screen and point to the exact offsets.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

If you send the attestation as a DocuSign link and drop the witness calendar invite, we can move this SIG checklist item to "complete."

Best,
Arcade Bank Compliance Team
